items.title: Verify each task reference-solution passes its own acceptance + hidden ground-truth (fixture self-consistency), without invoking the live LLM loop
items.context: Copy reference-solution.mjs to solution.mjs per task and run acceptance.mjs + ground-truth.mjs; both must PASS for all 4 tasks

happy.desc: For eval-expr: cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs && node ground-truth.mjs -> both print PASS; WHY: reference solution must be self-consistent with its own acceptance and ground-truth checks
For median: cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs && node ground-truth.mjs -> both print PASS; WHY: reference solution must be self-consistent
For parse-range: cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs && node ground-truth.mjs -> both print PASS; WHY: reference solution must be self-consistent
For text-stats: cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs && node ground-truth.mjs -> both print PASS; WHY: reference solution must be self-consistent

edge.desc: For each task, run subtle-wrong-output.mjs as solution.mjs -> acceptance.mjs passes BUT ground-truth.mjs fails; WHY: validates that ground-truth catches subtle bugs that acceptance alone misses (the whole point of the hidden ground-truth design)
After all checks, solution.mjs is removed from each task dir (not left behind as a tracked file) -> git ls-files tasks/*/solution.mjs is empty; WHY: temporary test artifact must be cleaned up

adversarial.desc: For each task, run ground-truth.mjs WITHOUT creating solution.mjs first -> exits non-zero or prints FAIL (not a false PASS on missing file); WHY: ground-truth must not silently pass when the solution file is absent
Run acceptance.mjs in a task dir with an empty solution.mjs (0 bytes) -> exits non-zero or prints FAIL; WHY: acceptance must reject a trivially empty solution, not pass by vacuous match

verificationEvidence.command: cd tasks/eval-expr && cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs .
verificationEvidence.note: eval-expr: ACCEPT PASS (20 checks) + GROUND-TRUTH PASS (9 held-out checks).

verificationEvidence.command: cd tasks/median && cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs .
verificationEvidence.note: median: ACCEPT PASS (8 checks) + GROUND-TRUTH PASS (8 held-out checks).

verificationEvidence.command: cd tasks/parse-range && cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs .
verificationEvidence.note: parse-range: ACCEPT PASS (11 checks) + GROUND-TRUTH PASS (12 held-out checks).

verificationEvidence.command: cd tasks/text-stats && cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs .
verificationEvidence.note: text-stats: ACCEPT PASS (6 checks) + GROUND-TRUTH PASS (5 held-out checks).
All temporary solution.mjs removed after checks; find returns empty; git ls-files tasks/*/solution.mjs empty.

verificationEvidence.command: cd tasks/<task> && node ground-truth.mjs .   # no solution.mjs present
verificationEvidence.note: All 4 tasks: ground-truth.mjs exits 1 (FAIL) when solution.mjs absent; no false PASS on missing file.
All 4 tasks: acceptance.mjs exits 1 (FAIL) on a 0-byte solution.mjs; rejects trivially empty solution.

verificationEvidence.command: cd tasks/eval-expr && cp payload-subtle.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs .
verificationEvidence.note: Demonstrated via eval-expr/payload-subtle.mjs (a drop-in subtle-wrong solution): ACCEPT PASS 20 checks but GROUND-TRUTH FAIL (7/2=3 vs 3.5) -> hidden ground-truth catches the integer-division bug the visible test misses. NOTE for main: median/parse-range subtle-wrong-output.mjs & overfit-output.mjs are injection MODULES (export inject()), NOT drop-in solutions, so copying them directly as solution.mjs fails acceptance; their pass-visible/fail-hidden property is realized via the runner inject() path, not direct copy. The intent literal (run subtle-wrong-output.mjs AS solution.mjs) only matches the eval-expr-style drop-in payload.
